description: Per-second data tiering panels plot seconds since the run started on the x axis, so several commits line up from second 0.

targets.rawSql: WITH recent AS (SELECT commit, MAX(timestamp) AS ts FROM benchmark_metrics_tiering WHERE test_type = '$config_name' AND (test_id = '$test_id' OR test_id LIKE '$test_id\_%') GROUP BY commit ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 60) SELECT to_char(r.ts, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || LEFT(r.commit, 8) AS label, m.command, AVG(m.rps) AS value FROM benchmark_metrics_tiering m JOIN recent r ON r.commit = m.commit WHERE m.test_type = '$config_name' AND (m.test_id = '$test_id' OR m.test_id LIKE '$test_id\_%') GROUP BY r.ts, r.commit, m.command ORDER BY r.ts, m.command
